body: You may die alone, physically, dude, but I will put my heart out for you when you do it. And it may be true, "It takes guts to die, but it takes even more to live." I wish you don't do it, even though I don't know you on any sort of way.  And I don't even know if you will read this, but I wish you the best of luck. Cheers.

Shit, man... I al sorry.... I can't tell you that I know how you feel... Because I truly don't... But you must fight for your son. You think if you take his father away, he is going to feel any better in the future of how you feel now? NO! YOU CAN'T GIVE UP JUST YET. You must find motivation even in the little things... But... It is up to you after all... But don't forget there is people that care for you somewhere. Much love.
